content:
I have a small PR that needs human review: https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/pull/6312

I wasn't sure how visible it is to the maintainers, so I wanted to draw attention to it here in order to clarify. Hope that is ok.
Chris, I saw you approved the PR: thanks! However, it seems it must be manually merged as well. Do you have permissions for that, or is it @Kim Morrison who needs to do that?
Ah it will need a second human review, so yes likely Kim or someone else will also need to approve it.

Ah, I understand. Just to be clear, there is no rush. This isn't a critical issue. I just have to explain to my agents how to work around/fix the script for every new session. So the PR just fixes an inconvenience on macOS.
Maybe @Cameron Freer can also approve?
No, it explicitly needs someone from the humans team which currently only has Kim.
@Kim Morrison would you mind having a look at this?
Oh I'm a human now, let's try this out

I saw you re-approved, but the check that says

changes outside TauCeti/ — human review + merge required

still doesn't want to budge. Is there a magic incantation needed?

Never mind, there it went in to the queue. Thank you!
